name: bug-physics-balance-jump
description: The built-in Walk walks on the spot, so its centre of mass moves slower than 0.2 m/s, and balance used to take it for standing: it rebalanced 15 frames with no blend, and the body jumped about 14 cm in a frame, which read as a 3.85 m/s pop at key 6. Its swinging foot moves faster than 0.5 m/s all the time, so it now doesn't stand: nothing is balanced, and there are no pops. The keyed loop has none either, its worst being 0.91 m/s.
